findings.mimic: Installed tests 706/1228-1249: target+gearing*reference+offset=0; TGS mimic velocity/position error correction explicit. Frozen gearing=-1 makes qf2=qf1 if offset=0.
findings.PhysX_online_version: Current ovphysx main documentation is 2026 and has codeless schemas/performance envelopes not automatically equivalent to installed Isaac 4.5. Installed schema/test/source are authoritative here.
findings.Pinocchio_reduced: buildReducedModel fixes named joints at a specified reference configuration, not an arbitrary upper-left mass slice. Constraint examples explicitly construct constraint models/data and constrain motion. Examples reviewed only; library not used as an Isaac-identical dynamics oracle.
findings.TSID: AccForce formulation computes full mass/nonlinear effects, contact Jacobian/force-generator and motion/force inequalities before extracting actuator effort. Eliminating effort variables does not eliminate physical constraint reactions.
findings.Franka: libfranka Robot realtime arm torque and Gripper hand operations are distinct; real FCI torque gravity/friction treatment differs from raw Isaac efforts. No hardware equivalence inferred.
findings.IROS2023: Bibliography and earlier QP6 abstract review retained. No newly obtained full paper; cooperative HQP/load allocation already prior art.
findings.Isaac_4_5_url: Direct open returned404, indexed version-specific page accessible through search; mimic instructions compared with installed tests, not silently replaced by latest docs.
